# Contributing to coven-scout

> ⚠️ **Contribution Freeze (until July 2026)**  
> We are currently only accepting **Issues and Bug Reports**.  
> Pull Requests will not be reviewed or merged until July 2026.  
> Please open an issue to discuss your idea — we'll revisit PRs after the freeze lifts.

---

## Reporting Issues

Please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/OpenCoven/coven-scout/issues) to report:

- Bug reports (with reproduction steps)
- Security vulnerabilities (please DM first for sensitive issues)
- Feature requests (labeled as such — we'll review post-freeze)

## Code of Conduct

Be kind. Be constructive. We're all building the future here.
